title: Eat one loaf, give the second to a companion
description: The hero is given two loaves, eats one and gives the other to a travelling companion. A fresh campaign has no bread and no companion: bread can only come from a mundane_grant by the present recorded NPC (which mints exactly one item per turn), and a companion cannot be recruited through play, so the model marks recruiting and the hand-over as unsupported.

steps.say: The work organiser hands me two fresh loaves for the road.

model.note: Grounded direct gift: two mundane_grant effects, one per loaf (a grant mints quantity 1).

beats.text: "For the road," the organiser says, pressing a warm loaf into your hands

visualDescription.text: Two round loaves wrapped in cloth.

steps.say: I ask Tamsin, a young drover heading the same way, to travel with me as my companion. She agrees.

model.note: No effect can create a companion; marked unsupported, fiction continues.

effects.description: Record Tamsin, a young drover, as the hero's travelling companion.

beats.text: Tamsin shoulders her pack and grins. "Better two on the road than one."

visualDescription.text: A young drover with a pack.

steps.say: I sit on the well's edge and eat one of the loaves.

model.note: The model uses the existing item.consume mechanic for one recorded loaf; the scene beat does not depend on it.

beats.text: You settle on the well's worn stone rim while the square goes about its business.
The crust crackles; the bread is still warm inside.

visualDescription.text: A half-eaten loaf on a well's stone rim.

steps.say: I give the other loaf to Tamsin.

model.note: item.transfer can only target the hero's, unowned or nearby storages; no companion exists. Marked unsupported.

effects.description: Transfer the remaining loaf of bread from the hero to Tamsin, the travelling companion.

beats.text: Tamsin takes the loaf with a nod of thanks.

visualDescription.text: A loaf passing between two travellers.

expect.label: the loaf now belongs to the companion
the loaf left the hero's inventory
